_purpose: GPU (TOPS) demand added to car_s4 by tools/arch_v3_gpu_demand.py (user 2026-11-05): the measured Autoware stack uses one camera network (traffic lights) and one lidar network, 2.65 TOPS raw for the whole car, far below what the reference designs size for; this file scales an Autoware reference design to the car's own sensors and adds cockpit AI to infotainment. Output: configs/arch_v3/<out>/ (swc.json, flows.json, chains.json), then tools/arch_v3_prepare.py --src configs/arch_v3/<out> --name <out>.

reference.name: Autoware PoV reference design, Vision Pilot Plus (Phase 2, SAE Level 3)
reference.sensor_set: 1 front RGB camera, 1 front 4D radar, 2 corner radars
reference.source: https://autowarefoundation.github.io/autoware.pov-reference-design-docs/main/system-configuration (rough GPU requirements: Vision Pilot 50-80, Plus 150, Pro 500, Vision Drive 1000 TOPS; 2025.09) and https://autowarefoundation.github.io/autoware.pov-reference-design-docs/main (sensors per tier)
reference.decision: user 2026-11-05: Plus; the same TOPS per sensor applied to our 8 cameras + 5 lidars (a lidar counted like a radar); the rho margins apply on top (rho 1: 488 TOPS raw x 3.32 = 1,617 TOPS)

camera_cpu_note: the template's measured CPU (12,860 DMIPS, the CPU side of GPU inference) capped at one target core, as tools/arch_v3_prepare.py does for the template
lidar_existing_note: CenterPoint runs on the concatenated cloud of all lidars; it carries the share of the front lidar (kit 'top' = LIDAR_Front), the other four lidars get their own network

infotainment.what: driver monitoring network on the driver camera
infotainment.source: OmniVision OAX4600 driver-monitoring ASIC, 2 TOPS NPU (https://www.iotm2mcouncil.org/iot-library/news/connected-transportation-news/2-tops-asic-for-driver-monitoring-launched/)

infotainment.what: voice assistant / cockpit AI, split equally over the voice-assistant components
infotainment.source: Qualcomm SA8295P cockpit SoC, 30 TOPS NPU (https://cnevpost.com/2021/11/29/jidus-first-model-to-feature-qualcomm-snapdragon-8295-chip-based-on-5nm-process), minus the 2 TOPS of driver monitoring

hw_catalogue_note: copied into the output directory, so tools/arch_v3_prepare.py uses this catalogue (partitions CPU / RAM / ROM only, GPU modules per cell) for the instance
